newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kone down sharply after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Kone down sharply after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Finnish lift maker Kone Oy fell sharply on Thursday as it warned 1996 earnings after taxes would be "close to zero" due mainly to heavy losses by its Italian operations.
At 1530/1230 GMT the share was marked down at 500 markka, down 35 markka or 6.5 percent, but it had scarcely traded as brokers said the market was still digesting the news.
"This came as a complete surprise," one broker said adding that the company had earlier indicated that losses from its Italian business would be in the tens of millions of markka.
"Now they say it will be 200 million," he said.
